evidence.title: Ballard closes acquisition of GeoPura, becoming an integrated hydrogen energy solutions provider | BLDP Stock News

occurrences.checkable_against: Ballard post-closing corporate disclosures and GeoPura acquisition announcement
occurrences.quote_span: The acquisition transforms Ballard into an integrated hydrogen energy solutions provider.
occurrences.speaker: Ballard Power Systems Inc.
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura

occurrences.checkable_against: GeoPura production-facility records and compressed-hydrogen fleet records
occurrences.quote_span: GeoPura also produces green hydrogen, generated via electrolysis, at its dedicated production facilities and transports it with the UK's largest compressed hydrogen distribution fleet.
occurrences.speaker: Ballard Power Systems Inc.
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura

occurrences.checkable_against: Ballard acquisition closing announcement and the two companies' product and business records
occurrences.quote_span: The combined business brings together Ballard's proven fuel cell technology and global scale with GeoPura's Hydrogen Power Units, fuel supply capabilities and Energy-as-a-Service business model.
occurrences.speaker: Ballard Power Systems Inc.
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura

occurrences.checkable_against: GeoPura HPU product and operational records
occurrences.quote_span: The company designs, manufactures, and operates their category defining Hydrogen Power Unit™, or HPU™, that offer clean, low noise, off-grid power with 6-9's reliability.
occurrences.speaker: Ballard Power Systems Inc.
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura

occurrences.checkable_against: GeoPura acquisition agreement and Ballard securities issuance records
occurrences.quote_span: The transaction agreement includes total upfront consideration of £275.0 million, comprising £82.5 million in cash, 49,584,212 newly issued Ballard common shares and restricted share units which will be settled in 12 months for an additional 1,084,540 Ballard common shares.
occurrences.speaker: Ballard Power Systems Inc.
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura

occurrences.checkable_against: GeoPura corporate records and Ballard acquisition announcement
occurrences.quote_span: Founded in 2019, GeoPura's mission is to deliver reliable, zero-emission power where and when it is required.
occurrences.speaker: Ballard Power Systems Inc.
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura

occurrences.checkable_against: GeoPura acquisition agreement earn-out provisions and Ballard milestone disclosures
occurrences.quote_span: Ballard may pay up to £27.5 million in additional contingent consideration upon GeoPura's achievement of specified post-closing financial milestones.
occurrences.speaker: Ballard Power Systems Inc.
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura

occurrences.checkable_against: Ballard board roster, director appointment filings, and transaction documents
occurrences.quote_span: In addition, Andrew Cunningham and Lord Richard Harrington, former UK Business and Industry Minister and Chairman of GeoPura, have joined Ballard's Board of Directors as nominees designated by the former GeoPura shareholders.
occurrences.speaker: Ballard Power Systems Inc.
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura

occurrences.checkable_against: Ballard executive appointment disclosure and corporate governance records
occurrences.quote_span: Effective with closing, Andrew Cunningham has assumed the role of President of Ballard, reporting directly to Chief Executive Officer Marty Neese.
occurrences.speaker: Ballard Power Systems Inc.
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura

occurrences.checkable_against: GeoPura HPU technical specifications and Ballard fuel-cell module records
occurrences.quote_span: Utilizing Ballard fuel cell modules at their core, these advanced systems convert hydrogen into clean electricity.
occurrences.speaker: Ballard Power Systems Inc.
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura

occurrences.checkable_against: NASDAQ/TSX BLDP historical trading data for Aug. 28, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: In the Aug 28 session, BLDP declined 3.85% , reflecting a moderate negative market reaction.
occurrences.speaker: StockTitan
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura

occurrences.checkable_against: Ballard capitalization table and acquisition closing disclosure
occurrences.quote_span: On a pro-forma basis, former GeoPura shareholders hold approximately 14.1% of Ballard's outstanding common shares.
occurrences.speaker: Ballard Power Systems Inc.
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura

occurrences.checkable_against: Ballard's Aug. 28, 2026 acquisition closing announcement and regulatory filing
occurrences.quote_span: Ballard Power Systems Inc. (NASDAQ: BLDP ) (TSX: BLDP ) ("Ballard"), a global leader in hydrogen fuel cell technology, today announced that it has closed the acquisition of GeoPura Limited ("GeoPura"), a leading UK -based provider of zero-emission, hydrogen-based power solutions.
occurrences.speaker: Ballard Power Systems Inc.
occurrences.subject: Ballard Power Systems acquisition of GeoPura
